name: Scheme for Cottage and Village Industries (Composite Loan Scheme)
benefit:
- Financial assistance (Term Loan and/or Working Capital Loan) up to a maximum of ₹25,00,000/- per unit.
- Loan proceeds may be used for assistance for fixed assets and/or working capital.
- Loan proceeds may be considered for the purchase of new machinery/equipment and to meet the working capital requirement.
- The maximum repayment period is 8 years, including a moratorium period of maximum 1 ye
_eligibility_text: 1. The promoter shall be a resident of Puducherry. 2. The applicant must belong to one of the following sectors - - Artisans Village and Cottage Industries sector. - Small Industries in the tiny sector. - Micro Enterprises projects. 3. The loan application purpose must be for assistance for fixed assets and/or working capital. 4. The cost of machinery must have a ceiling of ₹25,00,000/- per unit.
